name: prop-bolt
about: A gold lightning bolt on a neon base: streaks and power. Tripo v3.1 at its standard (low-credit) settings from concept prop-bolt-sd-0, one attempt.
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): an effect prop that flies in numbers (up to 12 at once): a lower-detail version of a simple shape, 512 px maps
